scope: Small author-created repository reading smoke test; not a repair benchmark or model ranking.

tasks.prompt: Read settings.py using read_file. Return only a JSON object with keys retry_count, timeout_seconds and retryable_status_codes, using the values from the file.
Read invoice.json using read_file. Compute subtotal as sum(unit_price * quantity), and total as subtotal + delivery_fee - discount_amount. Return only a JSON object with keys subtotal and total.
Read router.py using read_file. Determine its return values for /health, /admin/api/users, /api/users, /unknown. Return only a JSON object mapping these four paths to their integer return values.
